rev.t: Pricey. But so so so beautiful. Like any seller of block prints, they too have the kurtas, quilts, shirts and cushion covers. All super pretty of course. What really stands out is how whimsical some of their other things are. So delightful …

Suvasa is a stylish and contemporary clothing store located in the vibrant Indira Nagar area of Bangalore. As soon as you step inside, the store impresses with its elegant layout, neatly arranged collections, and a calm, premium shopping …

Today I had an excellent online shopping experience with Suvasa. Due to time constraints, couldn't visit the store so with the help of the staff got my order selected, packed and delivered to home. Wonderful experience. Special thanks to Satya, for such a smooth shopping experience. Thanks a ton Satya ❤️
